how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:fishing-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1579:obj:0: Bring 8 Gaffer Jacks to Wizbang Cranktoggle in Auberdine.
rows.quest:1579:details:0: I came to Auberdine because of the quiet. I want to invent my inventions where it's quiet, because after a night of drinking I don't like all the noise of ⟦E1⟧!
rows.quest:1579:details:1: BSo I took a ship to Auberdine and had a little too much to drink on the way. I dropped my box of gaffer jacks overboard! I need my gaffer jacks!
rows.quest:1579:details:2: BI don't know exactly where I dropped them, but if you fish for them in the ocean you might get lucky...
rows.quest:1579:completion:0: I can't believe you found them! You must be the luckiest ⟦1⟧ in ⟦E2⟧!
rows.quest:1580:obj:0: Bring 12 Electropellers to Wizbang Cranktoggle in Auberdine.
rows.quest:1580:details:0: We know you're lucky, but... just how lucky are you, ⟦2⟧?
rows.quest:1580:details:1: BOne night I was wandering the roads of ⟦E3⟧. I was looking for a good river or lake to try my new self-propelled, exploding duck decoy and I think I was a little tipsy... because I passed out and awoke hours later in Auberdine. My hair was singed and my bag of electropellers was gone! I must have dropped them in the water!
rows.quest:1580:details:2: BI need those electropellers! Maybe you can fish them out of some lake or stream in ⟦E3⟧...
rows.quest:1580:completion:0: I can't believe it! You found them! You are the best fisherman I've ever seen!
rows.quest:1580:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦3⟧. And here, take these. Although you're so good and you probably don't need them, they will help you with your fishing.
rows.quest:6607:obj:0: Nat Pagle wants you to catch the following fish:
rows.quest:6607:obj:1: BMisty Reed Mahi Mahi from the Misty Reed Strand in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:6607:obj:2: BA Sar'theris Striker from the Sar'theris Strand in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:6607:obj:3: BFeralas Ahi from the Verdantis River of ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:6607:obj:4: BSavage Coast Blue Sailfin from the Savage Coast of ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:6607:obj:5: BReturn to Nat Pagle when you have reeled them all in!
rows.quest:6607:details:0: Can't say I really enjoy fishin' much. Figure I been at it for a good 20 or 30 years now.
rows.quest:6607:details:1: BI reckon people are driven to do what they do for different reasons.
rows.quest:6607:details:2: BNow, I'm not saying you need to fish for 30 years or catch every fish in the sea to become a master fisherman. I reckon you just need to be determined - determined enough to sit on your duff for hours at a time, doin' nothin'.
rows.quest:6607:details:3: BI'll tell you what, catch me a few rare fish and I'll teach you a thing or two. Here's a list:
rows.quest:6607:completion:1: BCome over here, lemme show you how to set a few lines.
rows.quest:6608:obj:0: You think Lumak is trying to tell you that he can no longer help you improve your fishing skill. You may want to try to find his friend, Nat Pagle, a human fishing off one of the islands south of ⟦E8⟧ (at least that's what you think Lumak said).
rows.quest:6608:details:0: Lumak no can teach ⟦4⟧ no more. You too good! Find Lumak friend, Nat Pagle. Is human but no eat! Is Lumak friend! Nat teach you fish gooder.
rows.quest:6608:details:1: BYou find Nat in ⟦E9⟧, south of Humie town, Thermorosomethinglikedat. Nat probably fishing. Go now!
rows.quest:6608:completion:0: 'Course, you must be a friend of Lumak's.
rows.quest:6608:completion:1: BFishin'? I can tell you all 'bout fishin'.
rows.quest:6609:obj:0: ⟦E10⟧ to ⟦E2⟧, to the coastal city of ⟦E8⟧. From there you must search for an island, south of the main town. Nat Pagle awaits your arrival!
rows.quest:6609:details:0: I'm a dwarf fer cryin' out loud, ⟦5⟧! I ain't been designed to fish! I mean look at me! I'm practically made outta stone.
rows.quest:6609:details:1: BI got nothin' left - ye tapped me out. I've taught ye all I know, flipflop!
rows.quest:6609:details:2: BDon't ye get it? Ah, fine. I got an ol' friend over on ⟦E2⟧ who can help ye out. 'Is name be Nat Pagle, a fine lad. Find him on the islands south o' ⟦E8⟧. Git goin'!
rows.quest:6609:completion:0: I've always got room on my island for visitors... I reckon...
rows.quest:8193:completion:0: Hurry up and turn those in if you want to be declared the Master Angler! I have been standing around here for HOURS with nothing to eat! Hand those suckers over!
